name: Jebelyn Mediano
heroLine: Twenty-six years of you, and the world has never once been the same.

body: It's your special day today and I want to remind you of how special you are to me. Meeting you and having this wonderful chance to love you was the greatest gift you give to me, and allow me to share this back to you.

You are my most favorite human being and always remember how very special you are to me. I will be with you in your brightest moment and even in your darkest times. Even when you are full of doubts, I will be your guide to bring you back to where you should be and shine, by my side.
Let's celebrate this day together and enjoy your most special day. This day only belongs to you, my love.

photos.caption: In the cold dark night, Pale colors of life, Chivalrous of fight, That frightened my sight.
In solemnity I saw a beauty, Her scent was cherry,  Blossoms of Merry.
Every steps,  She makes me wonder, How the sorrow cease through her laughters.
She approach with no lie, She's a hue in my life,  A sweet lullaby,  A love I cannot hide.
She altered my mind continuously,  I fall for her love,  She is my  love.
We spoke of love and cities found of buried gold deep underground, How rivers sigh when lost to sea of whiskey poured in cups of tea
We spoke of art in golden frames of memories lost, forgotten names how shooting stars writes wishes bright and shadows fade into the night
We spoke of wolves and many things, of ticking clocks and circus swings, how crying doves fly up above, but most of all we spoke of love.

I will search for you in transient reveries and uncalled-for daydreams that revolve upon a storyline opposite to this version of reality— where we're not afraid to show what we really feel,  where we are able to hold hands freely while not minding their stares,  and where we won't have to sneak out just to see each other.
Luminate over the pitch black sky vast colors of everglowing crystals of the night yesterday's color start to burst only the soul can see  under the fireworks of our memory

Remember when I told you "No matter where I go I'll never leave your side You will never be alone" Even when we go through changes Even when we're old Remember that I told you I'll find my way back home
Show your face to me, shy moon make my heart sing make me swoon pull me closer like you do to the waves save me from sadness give me grace i really want to see the smile on your face

I'm not meant for casual love; I will devote to you like a dog, I will spoil you like a favorite child, I will learn you like a book, I will be selfish like a thief, I will talk things out and fight for you till hell freezes over

I have lived a thousand lives without you and within that came the burning in my soul. I have drowned in oceans, turned to ash in fires, and have been buried beneath the earth with the flowers that never grew back.
We used to dance all night until the sun rose. Then we'd dance until the sun made us sleepy. Until even the sun shook its head thinking, 'Who are these kids, crazy enough to beat me to the morning?
For nothing, not the sun, not the rain, not even the brightest star in the darkest sky, could compare to the wonder of you.
I've fallen. I've fallen deep, without warning, without anything to hold on to, and yet knowing the landing won't hurt.

quotes.text:
You are who I love, 
the girl under the umbrella, 
the fantasy, the conspiracy, theories, 
make-believe things that are actually true.

You are what I love,
 the depth, the inside jokes, the best friend.

You are when I love, 
a new history is being started with you, 
and we are young lovers that our older selves will someday reminisce about.

You are where I love, 
because I will go anywhere just to be with you.

You are why I love, 
because before you, I truly didnt understand what I was looking for, now that we found each other, 
you give my past and my future.. meaning.

reasons: The way you laugh before the joke has even landed.
How you say my name when you are half asleep.
Our grocery dates.
The way you dry my sweat without saying a word.
How you make any room we are in feel like home.
Your wonderful taste in everything.
The way sing me to sleep.
How you remember all the small things I forget.
Your patience with me on my worst days.
The face you make while laughing at my jokes.
How you share chika with me gladly.
The way you take my hand while walking.
Your kindness.
How you always know when to be there.
The sound of you while sleeping.
Your courage, quiet and constant when I need you.
The way you save the last bite for me.
How you react at your own stories.
Your cold hands finding mine.
The way you look up when I walk in.
How you make any day feel like something.
Your honesty.
The way you say “we” without thinking about it.
How safe the whole world feels beside you.
The way you forgive me — completely, every time.
That out of everyone there has ever been, it is you.

story.text:
I will put
you into words;
like a flower
that blooms
by spring;
like a florid leaf 
falling from 
an autumn tree;
or like a butterfly
fluttering its comely, 
little wings.

I will make 
a world for you;
it was something
I painted
in black and white,
but darling, 
you were more colorful 
than the 
complete spectrum 
of light.

I will remind 
you of your worth;
that you mean
something more precious 
than silver and gold;
not even diamonds, 
or any other 
fancy stones.

I will want your
good night;
those sweet 
late night calls
and
small talks
about anything 
crazy in life;
those constant hellos, 
and 
our beautiful goodbyes.

I will give you
my time;
how I spent 
hours of it
like it wasn't mine;
minutes felt like
they were made
just to make
you smile;
and 
seconds, 
were like rhythm
of my heart - 
it beats for you, 
since dawn 
'til night.

lockedLine: Everything here is sealed until the day itself.

wish.lit: Make a wish. I will help you keep it.
wish.done: Happy birthday. Here is to every year after this one.
